inj.note: Porter began Week 9 prep with a full practice session, but he was limited both Thursday and Friday due to the ankle issue. The star cornerback is now set to miss his fifth game of the campaign. Cobie Durant is a prime candidate to start in Porter's place Sunday.

news.h: Cowboys WR Pickens, CB Porter, LB Overshown inactive against Colts
news.d: The Cowboys will be without wide receiver George Pickens, cornerback Joey Porter Jr. and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown against the Colts.
